criteria.requirement: Extend TTLCache.expire(time=None,*,limit=None) with a validated nonnegative nonboolean integer limit. Return/remove at most that many expired pairs in original expiry order; zero removes nothing and None preserves exact legacy full cleanup. Repeated bounded calls must eventually remove all expired items without corrupting linked-list/LRU/weighted-size accounting or touching live entries. Invalid limits fail before timer sampling or mutation. Ordinary len/set/popitem still invoke default full expiry.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
